operators.name: Mumbai Monorail
operators.statusNote: MMRDA states: 'Monorail services in both directions between Chembur and Sant Gadge Maharaj Chowk will remain suspended until further notice.' Suspended since 20 Sept 2025 for rolling-stock replacement and CBTC signalling work. A restart has been reported as expected but requires final Urban Development Department clearance, which was still pending as of 6 Aug 2026. The line therefore MUST NOT be used for routing; its stations remain searchable so users are told it is suspended rather than finding nothing.

fareTables.source: https://themetrorailguy.com/mumbai-metro-aqua-line-information-route-map-fares-timings-tenders-status-updates/ ; corroborated by Free Press Journal and Newsband fare-structure reports
Range ₹10–₹40 and the Versova→Ghatkopar = ₹30 data point are widely reported (99acres, NoBroker, mumbaimetroroute). The intermediate slab boundaries are INFERRED.

Minimum ₹10 for 3 km and maximum ₹50 for 30 km are reported for Lines 2A and 7 (Free Press Journal, Oneindia, curlytales). Intermediate boundaries are INFERRED by mirroring the Line 3 structure, capped at ₹50.
Minimum ₹10 reported; sources DISAGREE on the maximum (₹30 vs ₹40 end-to-end). Fares were cut by about a third in September 2024 to lift ridership. Boundaries INFERRED.
